sentences.en: Layers of sediment lay at the bottom of the riverbed.
sentences.zh: 河床底部沉积着多层沉淀物。

sentences.en: By means of a super high-pressure water spray practically all the sediment is removed.
sentences.zh: 通过高压水喷射几乎可以清除所有沉积物。

sentences.en: The Mississippi River carries millions of tons of nutrient-rich sediment into the Gulf each year.
sentences.zh: 密西西比河每年向墨西哥湾输送数以百万吨富含营养的沉积物。

senses.zh: 沉淀物，沉渣；（最终形成岩石层的沙、石等）沉积物

mnemonic: sedi=sit（坐）+ment→沉下去的东西→沉淀物
